definitions.explanation: In baseball, a statistic measuring a batter's performance calculated by dividing the number of hits by the number of at-bats.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{今|こん}シーズンの{打率|だりつ}は3{割|わり}を{超|こ}えている。
examples.english: His batting average this season is over .300.

examples.japanese: {打率|だりつ}が{下|さ}がってスランプに{陥|おちい}った。
examples.english: His batting average dropped and he fell into a slump.

examples.japanese: リーグ{最高|さいこう}{打率|だりつ}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}になる。
examples.english: The player with the highest batting average in the league becomes the batting champion.

notes:
READING BATTING AVERAGES IN JAPANESE:
・.300 = 3{割|わり} (san-wari)
・.250 = 2{割|わり}5{分|ぶ} (ni-wari go-bu)
・.333 = 3{割|わり}3{分|ぶ}3{厘|りん} (san-wari san-bu san-rin)

RELATED BASEBALL STATISTICS:
・{防御率|ぼうぎょりつ} (ERA - earned run average)
・{出塁率|しゅつるいりつ} (on-base percentage)
・{打点|だてん} (RBI - runs batted in)
・{本塁打|ほんるいだ} (home run)
・{安打|あんだ} (hit)

BASEBALL AWARDS:
・{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ} (batting champion)
・{最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{選手|せんしゅ} (MVP)
・{新人王|しんじんおう} (Rookie of the Year)
